title: Chapter 587
paragraphs: Chapter 587
Episode 152. Quaul Ganesto (2)
Quaul reflexively reached out for the machine, and Jin lightly avoided his hand and tilted his head.
"You shouldn't try to snatch other people's things like that."
"Why is that yours!?"
"Because I took it from Zipfel."
"Hah! Zipfel, these idiotic bastards! They let you steal it from them?"
"You speak as if there's a reason this should belong to Zipfel."
Quaul had been reacting vehemently all along, but his face was now fluctuating between red and pale, a clear sign of his real anger.
Even his eyes were quickly bloodshot, and his hands and feet were shaking.
"These... these bastards! Dare to deceive me...!?"
"Did Zipfel deceive you?"
Jin's brows furrowed. He needed to hear more, but Quaul's animosity towards Zipfel was definitely advantageous for him.
"That's not Zipfel's, it's mine!"
"So, once again, we learn the lesson that we should take good care of our possessions."
"Give it back."
"You surely don't think the Runkandel family would spit out what they've taken, just because you said so."
This was not just a remark to provoke Quaul.
The mechanical device and the ship blueprints. How many sacrifices had been made in the Sota Desert to obtain these two things? They were obtained through the death of the Black Knight Jane.
It was so offensive to Jin that Quaul would even claim ownership of the items in front of him.
He didn't show his irritation only because the utility of a character like Quaul was beyond easy comprehension. If it were anyone else, he would have immediately held them accountable.
"Alright, I admit it. However, I would appreciate it if you could tell me where and how you got that item."
"Why should I do that?"
"Don't you want my skills?"
"That's a different matter. If you want to hear the backstory, this time you should tell me a story that would pique my interest."
Quaul gritted his teeth. The initiative had suddenly shifted.
He had never had his control taken away like this before.
Those who happened to discover his abilities, including Zipfel, had always just used meaningless threats and persuasion, ultimately resulting in nothing.
As an engineer, Quaul had always been the 'top'. Except for this moment, he certainly had been.
'These items seem to be more valuable to Quaul than I expected.'
Jin's assumption that as an engineer, Quaul would have a desire to complete his masterpiece, was correct.
Therefore, the capture was already halfway done.
The remaining issue was how cooperative he would be.
"Jin Runkandel, you said earlier that it's a teleportation device, right? It's not a teleportation device, it's a tool for instantaneous summoning. It's completely different from teleportation."
"What's the difference?"
"While teleportation, like a portal, has constraints due to the climate, this device doesn't have such constraints and can transcend time and space."
That's why the device was not called 'teleportation' but a 'time-space device'.
Jin couldn't help but be startled at Quaul's answer.
'If it can transcend time and space.'
It might be a technology that could bring his brothers in Lafrarosa.
Of course, he couldn't entirely trust Quaul's words. It could be just a bluff or he might be reading too much into it out of hope.
But the time-space device was, until recently, an impossible technology. Jin hadn't even heard of such technology in his previous life.
"Is that all?"
"That's all. For now. Now it's your turn to answer."

"It feels like a push and pull between lovers. I got the item from the Sota Desert. I acquired both the machine and the blueprints from a two-mast camel warehouse. It's more strange that you didn't know. Weren't you working at Zipfel when the Sota Desert incident happened?"
"Huh, so that's why you suppressed your anger when I claimed ownership. You must have made a lot of sacrifices."
"It's not an explicit expression, but it's interesting that you read into that."
"I apologize for that part. The device is clearly yours."
This time, Jin liked Quaul's attitude. It was somewhat strange and eccentric, but at least he didn't seem to be someone who didn't know the basics.
For a while, the two of them silently sorted out their thoughts.
The first one to break the silence was Quaul.
"And there's something you're misunderstanding, to be precise, I didn't create the item."
Jin had no choice but to take Quaul's words as a lie.
It was already revealed by Valeria's record magic that Quaul was the creator of the machine and the blueprints.
"Then who made it?"
"Rokia."
"What?"
"Rokia Ganesto. The mechanical device was not made by me, but by my distant ancestor. The time-space device I created through it was merely an attempt to restore the item from that time."
If Quaul's words were true, the time-space device was already created a thousand years ago.

A thousand years ago, Runkandel and Zipfel had much more powerful forces than now, and it was not uncommon to find artifacts called masterpieces that had far superior performance than cutting-edge technology.
The fact that the creator revealed by the record magic was Quaul is not entirely unexplainable. Since he improved an already existing item, he could also be considered its creator.
Above all, the historical manipulation of the Ten Great Knights, including Rokia Ganesto, has only slightly faded and is still in effect.
"So the blueprints were also made by Rokia Ganesto, not you?"

"If the blueprint you have is on paper, then I made it. But even that is a restoration through the artifact left by my ancestor. It's clumsy compared to the original that existed a thousand years ago, just like the time-space device."
That was new information.
Jin pretended to know that the original was in the form of a stone tablet, but Quaul just laughed.
"You wouldn't have been able to steal that, no matter how high or low you went. It's in the Tower of Stories, a one-mast camel."
"Was the original blueprint originally your property?"
"No, I wish it was. It has been Zipfel's property for a long time. It's different from the parts that were always with me before I started my research."
"My informant told me that the blueprint was started in 1775, and the parts in 1780."
"You have an impressive informant. But it's strange. The only ones who know the starting point of my research in Zipfel are Kelliak, Kadun, and Octavia..."
Quaul narrowed his eyes as if he had guessed something.
"Now I get it. Your informant, a survivor of Hister, right? Record magic. Without that, there's no way to know that information. Unless Kelliak Zipfel himself told you!"
Jin did not answer and observed Quaul's atmosphere. It seemed that some kind of desire was burning in his black eyes.

"Moreover, my real name. Even assuming that Kelliak could tell you, it wouldn't hold up. You could never know without record magic. You must have checked the device through record magic. You would have seen the name Ganesto there."
The existence of a survivor of Hister has been known for a long time among the major powers. And the fact that she is with Jin is something both major families have somewhat caught onto recently.
It was only natural for Quaul to make this much inference.
"Would you call it a leap?"
"It depends on what your basis for thinking so is."

"I've lived my whole life under the name Tinggen Bower. I only recently discovered my real name, Quaul Ganesto, after the world had descended into chaos. What else but record magic could have discovered it?"

The problem with the historical manipulation linked to the name 'Ganesto' only occurred about a month ago. The weakening of Zipfel's power due to Gliac was causing a butterfly effect between Jin and Quaul now.
And did Jin know something that Quaul didn't?
This wasn't the first time a problem had arisen with Zipfel's historical manipulation.
There were moments when the manipulation weakened around the time Quaul was born, and when his other ancestors lived.
In particular, the historical manipulation of the Ganesto family often had problems.
"It was a mistake not knowing that even Kelliak didn't know your name. Yes, a survivor of Hister is with me."
There was no need to hide it anymore. Jin continued to observe the desire in Quaul's eyes.
Quaul is a descendant of Rokia Ganesto and the world's top engineer. And what he wanted most was not wealth, power, or personal success, but the restoration and completion of technology.
Then the record magic, which only Hister could use, was the ability Quaul needed more than anything else.

"The conditions I was going to talk about to leave the hut were these. First, you will own the machine device. And secondly, you will recruit a person who can use record magic to assist me. So I had no expectation of you. Both seemed impossible."
Click, Quaul lit a cigarette as he spoke.
"The first condition is already met, and the second depends on how close a relationship you have with the record magician. Is it possible?"
"If it's a collaborator, not an assistant, it seems possible."
"Well, the issue of naming doesn't matter. Once they see my skills, they will think of themselves as an assistant."
Although he thought there was no way Valeria would ever do that, Jin nodded.
Rather, Jin had a picture of Quaul admitting to being Valeria's assistant.
Quaul reached out his hand to Jin.
"There will be no greater fortune for your life, your family, and all your forces than gaining me."
Jin shook his hand and replied.
"I will serve you as best as I can."
"What do you mean by 'as best as I can'?"
"It means welcome to the Barmel Alliance."
Although Quaul was upset, saying he had not yet joined, Jin easily suppressed him and threw him into Mote's mouth.
